Version 3.0.1

- Updated skill slug from security-rma-scripts to security-advisory-scripts in SKILL.md.
- Enhanced description and keywords for broader coverage and improved searchability.
- Added a new section summarizing the latest China securities regulatory updates and their impact on compliance (as of 2026-05-25).
- Bumped version number to 3.0.1 in the metadata.

Investment Advisory Scripts & Talk-Point Assistant skill initial release:

- Launches AI-powered script and talk-point generator for China wealth management professionals.
- Includes frameworks and templates for stock/fund recommendations, market commentary, client objection handling, and compliance-compliant communications.
- Features comprehensive trigger keywords (English & 中文) reflecting real-world advisory scenarios.
- Provides ready-to-use SOPs for objection handling and first-time client development.
- Integrates “禁说清单” and required compliance statements for regulatory adherence.
